text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! It's a massive event where fans 
are welcomed into the academy, but Bamboo 
Memory—

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Report! Incidents on the food stall 
street remain at zero! No notices to share 
from any stalls!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we're off to a smooth start!! Thanks 
for the report! Looking forward to working 
together going forward, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is Bamboo Memory! Food stall street 
is all clear! Continuing patrol!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As a member of the Disciplinary 
Committee, Bamboo Memory was on patrol 
duty to maintain order under the Student 
Council's direction, and I was helping her 
out.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's a huge turnout regardless, isn't 
it! I couldn't be happier!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like we can just barely catch the 
race Oguri Cap is in. Better hurry~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
—Mommy~, buy me that Oguri-chan doll over 
there~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
“—Anyway, Oguri's the priority! If I don't 
see Oguri with my own two eyes, there was 
no point in coming! Uwooooooh!!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's amazing! As you can see, a 
lot of people came just for Oguri-senpai, 
so it seems livelier than usual this year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Since so many people have come, we gotta 
make sure this year's event is safe too, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Hm? Is that...—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-san! Can I leave you to keep 
an eye on things here for a bit?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just some errands! I'll be right back once 
I'm done! Feel free to take a break if you 
want!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh* What in the world am I doing...—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Chiyonoooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was you, Chiyono O! What're you 
doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: B-Bamboo-san!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, Chiyono O, you're 
running in the carrot-eating race today, 
aren't you? It's almost time to gather!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Now that my comeback is officially 
decided, I have to show all my fans how 
lively I am!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah......... Um... that is――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Did something happen? Both when I saw 
you earlier and right now, you seem kinda 
down—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Is there really any point in me 
running?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My body has recovered enough to make a 
comeback, but... while everyone else has 
been growing in the Senior class, I 
haven't changed at all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the public doesn't even... 
remember last year's Japan Derby 
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's... looking at Oguri-san. She 
shines so brilliantly... While I, whose 
time has stopped, have faded away—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...That's not all. Deep down, I realized 
something."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They said that while I was resting... the 
peak of my growth had long since passed—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll just... stay like this forever. From 
here on, it's all downhill—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't get any stronger... I can't even 
chase after my idol... And on top of that, 
it feels like I'm being forgotten...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No way... A withered soul like me 
could...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Is there really any point... in standing 
before a crowd...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Of course I do!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to Chiyono O's 
comeback for so long! I want to see 
Chiyono O run again!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"It's because your running was that 
passionate, Chiyono O! Because your 
'dream' was shining so brightly!! I've 
been waiting for you all this time!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If even I crave it this much...! Then all 
of Chiyono O's beloved fans must be—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I'm waiting! For Chiyono O's 
comeback! How could I not be waiting for 
her to return?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So saying that nobody wants your 
comeback! Or that you've reached your 
limit! It's way too early to jump to 
conclusions like that!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I believe in Chiyono O's resolve to chase 
after her longing—her "dream"—once again, 
'ssu!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And I truly believe with all my heart that 
Chiyono O's fans are still eagerly waiting 
for her to run again!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —It's almost meeting time.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whether running truly has no meaning for 
Chiyono O, or if what I said was simply 
wrong...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...How about we check it out just for 
today?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—The highly anticipated carrot-eating race 
is about to begin! What kind of battle 
will we see this year!?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"We finally get to see Sakura Chiyono O 
run! It's been so long, I can't wait...!"

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I want to see Chiyono O-chan full of 
energy again real soon~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (See, I knew it—)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: —And now, the competitors enter the track!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Chiyonoo!! ...Wait, huh? Does she 
seem a bit... down?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Is she nervous? I wonder what's wrong...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Chiyonoo...—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-ray!! Hoo-ray!! Trai-! Ning-! Cen-! 
Ter-!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hello!! I'm a wandering one-girl cheering 
squad! Please join in and cheer along with 
me, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hoo-ray!! Hoo-ray!! Sakura! Chiyono! Ooh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just like this!! Please shout out the name 
of the Umamusume you want to cheer for!! 
Now, follow my lead!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hoo-ray!! Hoo-ray!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Fan A
text_block_list.text: A-Alright...! In that case, me too...!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-ray!! Hoo-ray!! Sakura! Chiyono! Ooh!! 
Go for it, go for it, Chiyono O!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Bamboo-san...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Was I... rushing things too much...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
......I'll give it my all again. So that I 
can bloom before everyone once more—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can chase my "dream" once 
more...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I'll cheer a bit more 
before heading back to Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hoo-ray!! Hoo-ray!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! I'm back, sir!! Sorry for 
taking so long!!
choice_data_list:
...Did your voice sound a bit hoarse just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh, to tell you the truth—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, upon learning why Bamboo 
Memory's voice was a little hoarse, I felt 
a sense of pride swell within me...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I'll cheer a bit more 
before heading back to Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hoo-ray!! Hoo-ray!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Bamboo Memory is here! And she's 
cheering them on!? I gotta join in on 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I-I get to cheer loudly right alongside my 
fave?! This is completely uncharted 
territory...! I'm so fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fans
text_block_list.text: Hooray!! Hooray!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? The cheers from the crowd just got 
way more heated?! I... can't afford to 
lose now, can I?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hooooray!!!! Hooooray!!!! Trai-! Ning-! 
Cen-! Ter-!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! I'm back, sir!! Sorry for 
taking so long!!
choice_data_list:
...Did your voice sound a bit hoarse just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh, to tell you the truth—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, upon learning why Bamboo 
Memory's voice was a little hoarse, I felt 
a sense of pride swell within me...
